senses.gloss:
n. (-रं)
1 Enmity, hostility.
2 Heroism, prowess.
E.
वीर a warrior, aff. अण्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Causing or occasioning enmity, mischief-making.
E.
वैर, and कर who or what makes.

m. (-रः)
An enemy.
E.
वैर, and कार who makes.

n. (-क्त्य)
Aversion, displeasure, dislike.
E.
विरक्त, and ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
An ascetic, a devotee, one who has subdued passion or desire.
E.
वि privative, रङ्ग passion, aff. ठक् or ठञ्.

n. (-नं)
Revenge, retaliation, requital of an injury.
E.
वैर enmity, निर्य्यातन donation, return.

f. (-या)
Revenge.
E.
वैर enmity, प्रतिक्रिया return.

f. (-द्धिः)
Revenge, retaliation.
E.
वैर enmity, शुद्धि purification.

n. (-गं)
Absence of worldly passion or desire.
E.
वि privative, राग passion, अण् aff. or with ष्यञ् aff. वैराग्य.

m. (-कः)
An ascetic, one with subdued passions.
E.
वि privative, राग passion, ठञ् aff.

m. (-गी)
An ascetic, a devotee, one who has subdued his worldly desires: at present the term in common use is applied to a particular class of religious mendicants.
E.
वैराग absence of passion, aff. इनि.

n. (-ग्यं)
Subjection of the appetite and passions, absence of worldly desires.
E.
विराग, and ष्यञ् aff.: see वैराग.

m. (-टः)
An earth worm.
E.
वि before राज् to shine, aff. क्विप्, and अण् added.

f. (-ट्या)
One of the sixteen goddesses of the Bauddhas, termed Vidyādevīs or goddesses of learning.

m. (-न्धी)
1 VIṢṆU.
2 The solar ray which is charged with heat.
E.
वैर heroism or strength, अनुवन्धिन् connected with.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Hostile, inimical, an enemy.
E.
वैर enmity used as a verb, with क्यङ् and शानच् affs.

m. (-हः)
Desperate or arduous combat.
E.
वैर enmity or heroism, आरोह ascending.

(-ता)
1 Enmity.
2 Heroism.
E.
वैरिन्, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, वैरित्वं.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Hostile, inimical.
m. (-री)
1 An enemy.
2 A hero.
E.
वैर enmity, इनि aff.

n. (-प्यं)
1 Deformity.
2 Difference of form, &c.
E.
विरुप, and ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-नः)
1 The third of the Buddhas, called Dhyāni Buddhas.
2 BALI, the sovereign so named.
3 The son of AGNI.
4 The son of SŪRYA, or the sun.
5 A Siddha, a sort of demi-god [] or deified mortal.
E.
विरोचन the sun, &c., and aff. of descent अण्.

n. (-नं)
Pātāla the intermediate region between the earth and Tartarus or Naraka, over part of which BALI presides.
E.
वैरोचन the prince BALI, and निकेतन abode; the sovereign of this name being an incarnate Daitya or hereditary foe of the gods, and being invested with a sovereignty in the lower regions after his humiliation by VIṢṆU.

m. (-निः)
1 A BUDDHA.
2 BALI.
3 The son of SŪRYA.
E.
विरीचन the sun, &c., and इञ aff. of descent.

m. (-चिः)
The demon or Daitya VĀṆA.

n. (-रं)
Revenge, retaliation.
E.
वैर enmity, and उद्धार a debt.
